name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 3 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 41 hours starting 2025-10-14, at wavelengths from 1.25 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
